messages:
Maya: ACME reported a regression after today's canary. Tiny prompt with an escaped quote now truncates the JSON output. ping @Ravi, attaching minimal repro and customer snippet.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout 2026-03-17-canary-42 deployed (commit: abcd1234). Traffic: 5% -> 20% started 1956789000.

Maya: Repro curl (customer provided):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2.1","input":"Generate invoice JSON for line: \"Item: Hosting, Qty:1, Price:$5\""}'
```

Maya: Customer observed output (truncated):
```json
{
  "invoice": {
    "items": [
      {"name":"Item: Hosting, Qty:1, Price:$5
```

Ravi: looking :eyes: Can you paste the canary id and the exact model variant? Also any recent tokenizer/serialization PRs?

deploy-bot: Active canary: 2026-03-17-canary-42 -> image: registry.redwood.ai/serving:2026-03-17-abcd1234, feature-flags: {tokenizer-v2:true}.

Chen: quick hypothesis: this looks like a tokenizer/serialization edge where a backslash-quote sequence is being split incorrectly and the output stream stops at an unterminated string. We merged tokenizer-v2 earlier this week (PR #789) which changed how escape tokens are handled.

Sam: severity? is ACME blocked in production or can they workaround? Any other customers?

Maya: ACME is blocked for invoice generation in their billing service (high severity). Support logs show 2 additional orgs with a single failing request each, but ACME is the only one with consistent failures.

Ravi: plan: 1) roll back canary to previous image, 2) open incident + hotfix to revert tokenizer-v2 toggle or add pre-processing to normalize escapes, 3) run targeted evals on our prompt suite. I'll start rollback unless anyone objects.

Chen: agreed. Quick mitigation: add pre-processor that normalizes lone backslashes before tokenization (safe short-term) and roll tokenizer-v2 flag to false. I'll prepare a PR to gate tokenizer-v2 behind a feature flag. We should run the invoice prompt testset (~2k examples) before re-enabling.

Ravi: initiating rollback now.

deploy-bot: Rollback triggered for 2026-03-17-canary-42 -> reverting to registry.redwood.ai/serving:2026-03-10-9876fedc. Rollback job id: rb-5509. Started 1956789060.

Maya: Notified ACME support contact, created INC-2026-243 and attached repro + raw curl. Asked for ETA and offered mitigation steps: send pre-escaped input through middleware.

Sam: good. Assigning owners: Ravi (rollback/infra), Chen (hotfix PR & evals), Maya (customer comms). If rollback fixes ACME, schedule postmortem and decide on canary gating.

Chen: opening PR to gate tokenizer-v2 now (link: https://git.redwood.ai/pr/812). Running evals against canary image should finish in ~25m.

Ravi: monitoring metrics. Will update channel when rollback completes and when ACME confirms success.

Maya: ACME acknowledges rollback notification and will test in ~10-15m.

Chen: quick note for postmortem: add targeted prompt templates with escape sequences to CI so we catch regressions to serialization/tokenization.

Maya: thanks team. Will follow up with customer outcome and add notes to the incident.
